posts.trend: 250+ job applications, zero callbacks: IIM Kozhikode MBA grad asks if anyone is hiring
posts.context: The recruitment process has become completely depersonalized, leaving mid-career professionals shouting into automated voids.
posts.angle: HR departments have built automated screens so efficient that actual human capability has become an administrative error.
slides: The standard response to your 200th job application.

"We received 4,000 applications."

"Your profile is impressive."

"We will keep it in our database."

"Please do not reply to this email."

The database is a graveyard.

HR is in a meeting.
posts.caption: They are processing your disappointment in batches. 🤖
posts.rank_verdict: Excellent deadpan delivery and a highly relatable corporate gut-punch that lands perfectly on a noun.
